title: Shinonome Ena — Happy Birthday!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Shinonome Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm home.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, good timing.
Dinner's just about ready.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay. Lemme go put my bag down...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm home.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, welcome home.
Dinner will be ready soon.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Oh, before I forget.
This is from my team.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? They got me a birthday present?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Looks like it. I told them they didn't have to...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Your teammates are so nice!
Oh, hey! These cookies are from that shop with all the bears, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I've been meaning to check it out for a while now. Thank them for me, okay?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, yeah.

rows.Speaker: Akito & Ena
rows.Line: I'm stuffed.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: How'd you like this cheesecake?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It was good. It felt like it sat somewhere between a souffle and something that was baked normally. But it was still really rich.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: How's Dad so good at finding these places?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, what does he have to do with this...?

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: He's the one that bought this cheesecake. He apparently found another good shop.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What?! No one said anything about that!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Also, you probably wouldn't have eaten it if I told you, right?

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. He said he won't be coming home because of work, so we can have his share.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Are you trying to fatten me up or something...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm taking it if you don't want it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Now just wait a second! I didn't say anything about that!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? Seriously, which is it...?

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. There's plenty left for you too, Akito. Bring me your plates, you two.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay.
Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (It's still before 25:00, but I wonder if anyone's on...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hey, Enanan. I had fun this afternoon. What's up?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Hello.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Oh, you're all here.
What were you doing just now?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <K and I were working on the lyrics.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I'm using the rough draft you sent me yesterday to get started on the storyboard.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Alright, I'll keep drawing stuff for you to use!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Thanks!
But before we do get back to the grind...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Enanan, you still have one hour left to celebrate your birthday. Is there anything left that you still want to do?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <That I still want to do?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I agree with Mizuki. If there's anything you want to do, I'd like to help. Well, within reason.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hmm... What do I still want to do...?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <So, nothing...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I'm still thinking!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But I'm drawing a total blank...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Wait, there is one thing...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mind if you all came along?
bgm_area00005
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ena. Oh, you're all here...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You're back already? We just celebrated your birthday.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I know. There's something I want to show you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Here, it's this sketch...
Can you three look at it too?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's why we're here, right♪

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Is this you at your desk, Ena...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. Remember that art class I went back to the other day? The theme for this one was “ourselves” and drew something with the same sort of layout and design...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But my teacher said, “I cannot tell what this person's feeling,” and, “There seems to be no point of focus.” So I decided to redraw it...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I made it look more like one of our illustrations, so I want to hear what you all think.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: This is how you see yourself, Ena...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
...
I don't understand...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What don't you understand...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: All of it. Nothing about it seems clear.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I agree. You can tell that you're trying your best to draw something, but outside of that...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmm... Okay...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I guess my expressiveness and layout ideas still have a long way to go...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Maybe...
But...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I like your drawing...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I think I like it too. I'm not really sure how to describe it, but I want to know more about what's going on!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Why's she trying so hard? What's she drawing? This drawing compels me to know more about this person.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. Okay...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Kanade. Everyone.
This is gonna be a long process...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I promise to learn how to really capture N25's music with my illustrations.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay. I'll be looking forward to that, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Miku, Rin, I'll be counting on you both too!

rows.Speaker: Miku & Rin
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Ena!

rows.Speaker: Kohane & Toya
rows.Line: Happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You guys are so old-fashioned...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: She's your sister, Akito, and you've done so much for us.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What does she have to do with us? Also, she's done nothing for me as far as I know.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Anyway, happy birthday.
It's good to see you drawing again, but don't push yourself too hard, alright...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Ena♪
I'm glad you enjoyed our little shopping trip.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. The face you made when you saw our surprise cake was priceless too!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
We should go again sometime.
Next time we could... Oh, how about we go on a dessert tour?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Great idea! We can show each other all our favorite shops and hidden gems! Try to keep some places in mind for us, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Ena!
Thanks for always drawing such great illustrations and materials♪ Video editing's way more fun because of you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You've shown genuine concern for my well-being, so feel free to ask me for help if you ever think you need it. In the meantime, let's keep having fun!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Happy birthday...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I don't have much to say...
But there are times when you're able to say what no one else is willing to, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't know if it'll help me change, but I'd like it if you could just keep speaking your mind...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Your illustrations usually show hints of pain and suffering, but also this warmth and kindness that can bring people closer together.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I think that's the reason you're able to create visual representations of our songs.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I really like what you draw, Ena.
So I hope you get to keep drawing the way you want.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: There was a time when just having cheesecake was enough for me in terms of celebrating my birthday...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But it's nice to celebrate with real friends like this. It even motivates me to keep drawing.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I need to get better to draw illustrations that do N25's songs justice.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I have to face my art and somehow make up for the two years I lost.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm gonna do what I can, so I'll be counting on you for support, okay?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Bye bye.
